notes: m21-fidelity item 1 (2026-10-29). Printed: 'Reach, hexproof from blue'. CR 702.11d: hexproof from [quality] means the permanent can't be the target of [quality] spells an opponent controls or abilities an opponent controls from [quality] sources; any other spell may target it. So the opponent's blue Unsubstantiate is refused, and the opponent's red Unleash Fury targets it and doubles its power (1 -> 2). Before the fix the compiler also gave the card a bare HEXPROOF (MTGJSON lists 'Hexproof' next to 'Hexproof from'), so the red spell was refused too: full hexproof, stronger than printed.
